text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, when I entered the trainer's 
office, K.S.Miracle was sitting there 
holding an ice pack to her temple.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Trainer-san. Actually, I've had a 
headache since this morning...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Still, don't worry. I know how to deal 
with this!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Migraines are caused by the dilation of 
blood vessels. In other words, you should 
cool down the area around your temples."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Also, there's an acupressure point that 
helps with headaches. Right around the 
second knuckle of the ring finger. 
Pressing it seems to work really 
well—fufu.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I've always been prone to illness, so I 
just happen to know a lot about stuff like 
this."
choice_data_list: How is it? Think it'll heal?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yes. If we do this much, surely—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha. I do have the theoretical 
knowledge, though...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
K.S. Miracle seemed to be troubled by a 
headache...
